intro_html: Kofta are the Middle East's proof that ground meat deserves better than burger night: herb-packed turkey skewers with warm spices under a river of lemony tahini sauce. Each bowl brings 35 grams of protein for about $2.23.
cost_closing_html: About $2.23 a bowl for turkey kofta with tahini sauce. A Mediterranean fast casual chain charges $13 for a smaller bowl and calls the extra tahini an upcharge. Yours is included.
shop_smart: Ground turkey carries the batch at about $12.71 for 3.5 pounds. It takes on the mint, cilantro, and warm spices so well that nobody misses the pricier lamb.
Tahini is the splurge line, this recipe uses a full 3.5 cups. Buy the big jar, per ounce it costs far less than the small one, and it keeps for months for dressings and hummus.
Fresh mint and cilantro cost a couple dollars a bunch and transform lean turkey. That is the cheapest flavor upgrade in the store, use the stems too.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.

Mix the ground turkey with the minced garlic (save a third of it for the sauce), grated onion, chopped mint, cilantro, eggs, bread crumbs, and the spice blend of cumin, oregano, cinnamon, allspice, cloves, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes. Mix just until it comes together.
Shape the mixture into oval kofta, about 3 per serving. Wet hands make this far less annoying.
Bake at 400F for 18 to 20 minutes, or sear in a hot pan, until browned and 165F in the center.

Make the tahini sauce: whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, the reserved garlic, a big pinch of salt, and enough cold water to reach a pourable, creamy consistency. It will seize up first, keep whisking, it comes back.
Build bowls with the kofta and a generous spoon of tahini sauce over the top.
Store extra sauce in a separate container if you like it fresh, it also holds up fine mixed in.
portion_html: Weigh your finished kofta and sauce in the pot, subtract the empty pot weight you wrote down, and divide by 14. Portion to that number and each bowl lands at about 594 calories with 35 grams of protein.
upsell_html: Hearty dinners for about $2.23 a bowl. This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.

steps: Mix ground turkey with garlic, grated onion, mint, cilantro, eggs, bread crumbs, and warm spices.
Shape into oval kofta, about 3 per serving.
Bake at 400F or sear until browned and 165F inside.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and cold water into a pourable sauce.
Assemble bowls with kofta and tahini sauce, then portion into 14 containers.
